notes: Normal release on aa1ca3d plus sender-offload-budget-experiment.patch. Only the offload floor in QuantizationBudget changes from one to three send quanta. The matching private unit-test expected floor changes from 9000 to 12000; all other test expectations are unchanged.
Control remains 4 MiB/s and combined DATA bursts retain the single-quantum/64-datagram limit. No memory/buffer, wire, ACK scheduling or MTU change. Loss/recovery inflight caps continue to apply.
339 ordinary release tests, all-target/all-feature musl Clippy passed. Full kernel and routed PMTU acceptance were not run for this policy experiment.
Experimental policy tuning, not a verified defect in the allowed one-quantum draft-07 baseline. Neither performance target is met.
Four 20-second retained-daemon points; no builds or other tests overlap load.

Directions L->R/R->L, endpoint arrays L/R; goodput excludes drain, missing ratios include drain. 100% CPU equals one core. TAP SKB drops, frame expiry and queue entries cannot be summed into exact frame loss.
No 20 Gbit/s local gate, real-path gate or CPU ceiling is established.
